description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression, function, or script file in the context of the page (MAIN world first, with CDP Runtime.evaluate fallback) and return or save the serialized result. Supports resolving @ref/CSS selector arguments (args) into live DOM Elements, loading scripts from sourcePath, and saving large outputs to filePath.

args.description: Optional arguments passed to the evaluated function; @ref or CSS selector strings (e.g. '@1', '#modal') are resolved to live DOM Element arguments in MAIN world

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

expression.description: JavaScript expression or function to evaluate (e.g. '(el) => el.textContent')

filePath.description: Optional local file path to save the JSON-serialized evaluation result to disk

script.description: Alias for expression: JavaScript expression or script to evaluate

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after evaluating

sourcePath.description: Optional local file path to load JavaScript source from instead of inline expression

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after evaluating

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after evaluating

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after evaluating
